notes.title: New playable prostitute!
notes.content:
[p][b]Welcome to the best prostitute simulator in the world.[/b][/p][p][b][i]This time, in patch 1.5, we bring you a major improvement. [/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]Now you can choose a new girl to complete the main story.[/i][/b]

[img src="https://i.postimg.cc/QMVvJMfX/Elige2.png"][/img][/p][p]Choose the one you like best and enjoy your life as a prostitute.
[/p][p]·New girl added to the roster.[/p][p]·New dance animations.[/p][p]·Some mechanics have been improved.[/p][p]·A bug has been fixed when using the unlocked street dancing skill.[/p][p]·Texts in different languages have been corrected.
[/p][p][b][i]It's time to enjoy twice as much now! Have fun.[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Great success in sales and game improvements.
notes.content:
[p]Thank you all for the great success of the third installment of the best prostitution simulator in the world!  We have listened to your feedback and we are working on adding new content, also today we have a patch with an adjustment that much of the community has requested and some bug fixes.  

-We have changed the difficulty so that some cops appear randomly or not, this can make the game easier and different in each game.  

-Fixed a bug with the configuration menu that did not allow to change the options on some computers.  

-Fixed a few minor bugs.[/p][p][/p][p]-Text corrections in a few languages.
[/p][p]We will continue working and improving the game with your support and next updates.[/p]

notes.title: Day 1 patch
notes.content:
Today is the release day of Prostitute Simulator 3. To celebrate we have just uploaded a patch with bug fixes and other quality of life improvements.
Enjoy the game and please leave us your comments and suggestions.
Thanks!
